name: analyze-account-linear
description: Deep dive on a modern developer tools company. Should surface plausible personas and real competitor names.

businessContext.overview: Real-time performance analytics for engineering leadership.

expectations.rubric: The seller is GridPulse (engineering performance analytics). Competitors here means engineering-analytics / observability / dev-productivity vendors that Linear likely USES today — the tools GridPulse would displace. Recognizable good answers: Jellyfish, LinearB, Waydev, Code Climate, Sleuth, Swarmia, Datadog engineering metrics, homegrown dashboards. Score low if the list is cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Algolia) or Linear's own market competitors (Jira, Notion).

A great counter-narrative names a concrete objection, offers a specific reframe (not generic reassurance), grounds proofPoint in a real analog example or data point, and specifies a moment in the sales conversation. Vague or LLM-boilerplate counter-narratives score low.
